title: Franxx
body:
"I was putting together a bunch of songs for this
and this mix ended up being like such a random mix of hyperpop and electro sounds and energies but the entire time it felt like this is what my summer gave but also what it should've given, somewhere in between what i wanted and what actually happened came this mix -- maybe i'm the only person who feels sentimental about any of these tracks hahahaha "
